blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.
blocks.zh: 高真性4D物理模拟需要精确的物理参数任务,与不同的物质属性相配合. 以往的方法与关键瓶颈相抗衡:它们要么依靠计算强度的每层优化,要么通过纯粹的视觉输入来预测参数. 后者有内在的模糊性,例如无法区分橡胶的硬度与外观本身。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出AutoPhyX,这是预测空间变化物理属性的文字条件框架. 由于训练有素的进取饲料模型需要精细的监管,我们首先引入了一个新的可控制部分的数据生成管道,将复杂的立体资产分解成精密相通的组件并配以物理上可信的,多样的参数和相应的文字描述. 利用此数据集,AutoPhyX采用了跨模式的调制机制,其中文本具有动态调制可视特征,用于精确的物理地平面. AutoPhyX通过在一个活性场内制定属性预测,确保了与包括 meshes,点云,高斯平板化,和NeRF等多种3D表示的相容性. 实验表明,我们的方法能够使物理上可行的、文字驱动的参数在单一的前进通道中分配。 它实现了高精度和强力地将各种物体普遍化,为未来的物理学密集型和机器人应用铺平了道路。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation [ 48 , 36 , 40 , 27 ] has become a vital foundation for interactive digital environments, driving applications ranging from fem ( fem ) based [ 31 , 5 , 2 , 4 , 6 ] robotic policy training, to sph ( sph ) driven [ 32 , 34 , 33 , 35 , 43 , 39 , 26 ] complex fluid and glacier calving simulations, and mpm ( mpm ) powered [ 14 , 3 , 19 , 46 , 42 , 9 , 10 , 46 , 21 , 47 ] real-time virtual reality (VR) experiences. Despite their ability to synthesize high-fidelity, realistic dynamics across diverse scenes, these physics-based approaches share a major bottleneck: they rely heavily on the manual assignment of physical parameters. This reliance on trial-and-error parameter design severely limits their scalability and applicability to complex scenes characterized by diverse, spatially varying materials.
blocks.zh: 高纯度4D物理模拟[48,36,40,27]已成为交互式数字环境的重要基础,驱动应用从基于fem(fem)的[31,5,2,4,6]机器人政策训练到sph(sph)驱动[32,34,33,35,43,39,26]复杂的流体和冰川钙化模拟,以及mpm(mpm)驱动[14,3,19,46,42,9,10,46,21,47]实时虚拟现实(VR)体验. 尽管它们能够合成不同场景的高度真实,现实的动态,但这些基于物理学的方法有着共同的重大瓶颈:它们严重依赖物理参数的人工分配. 这种对试验和过分参数设计的依赖严重限制了其可伸缩性和适用于以不同、空间不同的材料为特征的复杂场景。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Text-driven physical simulation with AutoPhyX. Our framework predicts dense physical parameters for 3D assets conditioned on textual descriptions. For each scenario, the leftmost images visualize the predicted voxelized physical parameters, which are normalized and mapped to RGB channels, corresponding to the input text. Under identical boundary conditions, the resulting simulations exhibit distinct behaviors, e.g . , the bonsai responding differently to the same wind force in MPM, and the box with different deformation under the same robot grasping policy in FEM.
blocks.zh: 图1:文本驱动物理模拟与AutoPhyX. 我们的框架预测了以文字描述为条件的三维资产密集的物理参数. 对于每一种情景,最左边的图像可视化预测的阴性化物理参数,这些参数被正常化并映射到RGB通道,与输入文本相对应. 在相同的边界条件下,所产生的模拟表现出不同的行为,例如,Bonsai对MPM中相同的风力有不同的反应,而盒子在FEM中相同的机器人抓住政策下有不同变形.

blocks.en: Existing methods aiming to automate material acquisition primarily fall into two categories, each with its own limitations. Optimization-based methods [ 25 , 17 , 54 , 51 ] leverage differentiable physics to iteratively refine material fields to match target observations. However, inferring particle-wise parameters from sparse supervision is ill-posed and computationally expensive, often requiring hours of per-scene optimization [ 25 ] and offering limited generalization across scenes. In contrast, feed-forward approaches such as Pixie [ 22 ] and VoMP [ 13 ] enable much faster inference; yet they rely purely on visual cues, which sacrifices semantic controllability and suffers from appearance ambiguity. For example, as shown in Figure 1 , a tree could feature flexible branches that sway in the wind or brittle wood that fractures easily, while a biscuit box could be rigid cardboard or thin paper. Without explicit semantic guidance, it is difficult to disambiguate objects that are physically distinct but visually similar.
blocks.zh: 旨在实现材料获取自动化的现有方法主要分为两类,每类都有自己的局限性。 基于优化的方法 [25, 17, 54, 51] 利用不同的物理学来迭代完善材料领域,以匹配目标观测. 然而,从零星的监管中推断出粒子参数,是不合理和计算昂贵的,往往需要几个小时的人均场景优化[25],并且提供有限的跨场景的泛化. 相比之下,像Pixie [22] 和VOMP [13] 这样的向导方法能够更快的推论;然而它们却完全依赖于视觉提示,它牺牲了语义的可控性,并受到外观模糊的影响. 例如,如图1所示,一棵树可具有柔性树枝,在风或脆木中摇摆,容易断裂,而饼干盒可以是刚性纸板或薄纸。 没有明确的语义指导,很难将物理上与众不同但视觉上相似的物体分开。

blocks.en: To address these critical limitations, we propose AutoPhyX , a feed-forward framework for fast, generalizable, and semantically controllable prediction of physical properties. Given a 3D asset and textual descriptions of its physical properties, the model predicts spatially dense physical parameters in a unified voxel field representation. This formulation provides a common physical abstraction that can be directly transferred to diverse downstream 3D formats, including gs ( gs ), meshes, and point clouds, without per-scene optimization. To resolve the material-level ambiguity and capture spatially varying properties across multi-part, multi-material assets, AutoPhyX modulates the intermediate visual representation with a feature-wise affine transformation conditioned on the encoded text features, coupling high-level semantic cues with fine-grained spatial representations. This cross-modal design enables the model to distinguish visually similar but physically different materials, while also assigning spatially coherent physical parameters to semantically distinct parts of the 3D asset.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些关键限制,我们提出AutoPhyX,一个快速,通俗,可控制地预测物理属性的反馈框架。 鉴于其物理属性的3D资产和文字描述,该模型在统一的voxel字段代表中预测空间密集的物理参数. 这种配体提供了一种共同的物理抽象,可以直接转移到不同的下游3D格式,包括gs(gs),meshes,以及点云,而无需对每个场景进行优化. 为了解决材料层面的模糊性,并捕捉跨多部分,多材料资产的空间差异属性,AutoPhyX对中间视觉表现进行调制,在编码的文本特征上以特征为条件的亲和变换,将高级语义提示与精细的空间表现配合. 这种跨模式设计使该模型能够区分视觉上相似但物理上不同的材料,同时也将空间上一致的物理参数指定为3D资产中与众不同的部分。

blocks.en: Training such a robust, spatially-grounded model requires large-scale fine-grained supervision over multi-part, multi-material 3D assets with text descriptions, which is currently unavailable. To bridge this gap, we introduce an automated, part-controllable data generation pipeline. For each asset, we construct a 3D OpenCLIP [ 18 ] voxel representation, and leverage authoritative engineering databases ( e.g . , MatWeb and Wikipedia) and vlm to extract robust text-guided part segmentation, assign plausible material properties, and generate diverse part-aware textual descriptions. Our dataset, Text2PhyX , features 1,700 high-quality 3D assets, each paired with 8 distinct physical-parameter and text-description annotations, supplementing as training and testing data for text-conditioned physical property assignment.
blocks.zh: 培训这样一个扎实的、以空间为基础的模型,需要对多部分、多材料的立体资产进行大规模精细监管,并配有文字说明,目前尚不具备文字说明。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了一个自动化、可部分控制的数据生成管道。 对于每个资产,我们构建一个3D OpenCLIP [18] voxel 代表,并利用权威的工程数据库(如MatWeb和Wikipedia)和vlm来提取强力的文本引导部分分割,指定可信的材料属性,并生成多样的有部分意识的文本描述. 我们的数据集Text2PhyX拥有1 700个高质量的三维资产,每个资产配有8个不同的物理参数和文字描述说明,作为文字条件的实物财产分配的培训和测试数据。

blocks.en:
We evaluate AutoPhyX extensively on Text2PhyX and the real-world ABO-500 [ 51 , 11 ] dataset, achieving state-of-the-art quantitative results on both. Specifically, our method improves the PSNR from 23.421 23.421 to 26.012 26.012 on our dataset and reduces the Average Displacement Error (ADE) by 20 % 20\% compared to the second-best method on ABO-500.
Furthermore, our predicted properties support a wide range of physical simulators, which we demonstrate through extensive results using both MPM and fem . This versatility allows us to flexibly choose rendering and simulation pipelines on demand, e.g . , gs for real-time dynamic rendering, mesh rendering in Blender, or Isaac Gym for robotic policy training.
blocks.zh:
我们在Text2PhyX和现实世界的ABO-500[51,11]数据集上广泛评价AutoPhyX,在两者上都取得了最先进的定量结果. 具体地说,我们的方法改进了PSNR,在我们的数据集上从23.421 23.421到26.012 26.012,并将平均流离失所误差(ADE)比ABO-500上的第二好方法减少20% 20%。
此外,我们预测的特性支持广泛的物理模拟器,我们通过使用 MPM 和 fem 的广泛结果来证明这些模拟器。 这种多元性使我们能够根据需求灵活选择渲染和模拟管道,例如:gs用于实时动态渲染,wesh渲染在Blender,或Isaac Gym用于机器人政策训练.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are: • The first text-conditioned feed-forward framework for 3D physics prediction. We introduce AutoPhyX that achieves precise semantic and physical grounding through a novel cross-modal modulation architecture, resolving the inherent ambiguity of previous pure-vision methods. • A large-scale, multi-part, multi-level 3D physics dataset. We build Text2PhyX with dense part-aware physical annotations and paired text descriptions, enabling supervised learning for text-conditioned property prediction with an automated vlm -driven generation pipeline. • Extensive validation across diverse workflows. We demonstrate that AutoPhyX significantly outperforms existing baselines in physical accuracy. More importantly, our approach bridges the gap between static 3D assets and various physics solvers, providing a plug-and-play solution that generalizes across varied representations, platforms, and rendering engines.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献是: 3D物理预测的第一个文本条件feed-forward框架. 我们引入了AutoPhyX,通过一种新型的跨模式调制架构实现精确的语义和物理地基,解决了之前纯视方法的固有模糊性. • 支助 一个大规模,多段,多层次的3D物理数据集. 我们构建了Text2PhyX,其内容是密集的部分知觉物理注释和对齐的文本描述,使得能够通过自动vlm驱动的生成管道对文本条件属性预测进行有监督的学习. • 广泛验证各种工作流程。 我们证明,AutoPhyX在物理准确性方面大大超过现有基线。 更重要的是,我们的方法弥合了静态3D资产和各种物理解析器之间的差距,提供了一个插值和游戏解决方案,将各种表达、平台和渲染引擎概括起来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Physical simulation has long been a cornerstone of computer graphics
. Typical simulation methods, e.g . , fem , which models stress-strain responses for rigid and soft bodies, and mpm [ 19 , 14 ] , particularly suited for large deformations and complex materials, have been widely adopted. Despite their success, they all rely on accurate physical parameters as input. In this work, we are particularly interested in three canonical properties: Young’s modulus E E , Poisson’s ratio ν \nu , and density ρ \rho , because they jointly govern a material’s stiffness, lateral deformation behavior, and inertial response, making them fundamental for a broad range of solid and deformable simulations. To eliminate the need for manual parameter assignment, prior efforts can be broadly grouped into the following directions.
blocks.zh:
物理模拟一直是计算机图形的基石
。 。 。 典型的仿真方法,例如fem,用于模拟刚性体和柔性体的应力极限反应,和mpm [19,14],特别适合大型变形体和复杂材料,被广泛采用. 尽管它们都取得了成功,但它们都依赖于准确的物理参数作为输入. 在这部作品中,我们尤其关注三个犬科属性: 年轻人的模态E, Poisson的比值 和密度 \rho, 因为它们共同支配着材料的僵硬性, 横向变形行为, 和惯性反应, 使它们成为广泛固体和可变形模拟的基础。 为消除人工参数分配的需要,先前的努力可大致分为以下几个方向。

blocks.en: 2.1 Physics Property Assignment via vlm
blocks.zh: 2.1 通过 vlm 分配物理属性

blocks.en: Prior research, such as NeRF2Physics [ 51 ] , directly prompts vlm to predict exact physical parameters from images [ 8 , 51 , 16 , 7 ] . However, this direct approach struggles for three main reasons: vlm lacks accurate built-in physics knowledge, their outputs are highly random, and materials suffer from severe visual ambiguity, where objects that look identical can have completely different physical properties. To overcome these issues, we shift the vlm ’s role from a direct physics calculator to a semantic reasoning engine supported by external tools. Specifically, instead of relying on the vlm to guess exact numbers, we give specific material requirements, e.g . , more deformable or crisp, and prompt it to query external databases to find reasonable physical ranges. To handle the randomness of vlm outputs, we query the model multiple times and select the best result. Finally, we use the vlm to generate text descriptions that explicitly define the material, effectively solving the visual ambiguity problem.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究,如NERF2Physics[51],直接促使vlm从图像中预测准确的物理参数[8,51,16,7]. 然而,这种直接的方法挣扎有三个主要原因:vlm缺乏精确的内置物理知识,其输出高度随机,材料有严重的视觉模糊性,看起来相同的物体可能具有完全不同的物理性质. 为了克服这些问题,我们把vlm的作用从直接物理计算器转移到由外部工具支持的语义推理引擎上. 具体来说,我们不是依靠vlm来猜测确切的数字,而是给出具体的材料要求,例如,更可变形或更脆,并促使它查询外部数据库以找到合理的物理范围. 为了处理 vlm 输出的随机性,我们多次查询模型并选择最佳结果. 最后,我们使用vlm生成文本描述,明确定义材料,有效解决视觉模糊问题.

blocks.en: 2.2 Test-time Physics Property Optimization
blocks.zh: 2.2 试验时间物理特性优化

blocks.en: Another prominent line of research focuses on test-time optimization, which iteratively refines physical parameters to align simulations with target observations. Observation-based optimization techniques [ 37 , 23 , 55 , 20 , 53 , 50 , 20 , 28 , 52 , 24 ] typically minimize the discrepancy between simulated deformations and ground-truth data, such as multi-view videos or particle trajectories under known forces. While effective, these methods often require high-quality, dense supervision that is difficult to acquire in real-world settings.
blocks.zh: 另一条突出的研究线侧重于测试时间优化,该线迭代完善物理参数,使模拟与目标观测一致. 基于观测的优化技术[37, 23, 55, 20, 53, 50, 20, 28, 52, 24] 通常将模拟变形数据与地面真实数据之间的差异最小化, 如多视视频或已知力下的粒子轨迹. 这些方法虽然有效,但往往需要高质量的、密集的监督,在现实环境中很难获得。

blocks.en: To alleviate this dependency, approaches [ 17 , 54 , 25 ] propose leveraging pretrained video diffusion models to guide physics discovery via motion distillation losses. Notable examples include PhysDreamer [ 54 ] and DreamPhysics [ 17 ] , which optimize material fields by ensuring simulated dynamics remain consistent with realistic motion priors. Despite their ability to discover physics from sparse inputs, these optimization-based paradigms suffer from extensive computational overhead, often requiring hours of optimization to resolve hundreds of thousands of material points. Furthermore, these methods are characterized by heavy per-scene memorization; for each new scenario, the costly optimization must be executed from scratch, failing to generalize across diverse scenes.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻这种依赖性,方法[17、54、25]提议利用预先训练的视频传播模型,通过运动蒸馏损失指导物理学的发现。 显著的例子包括PhysDreamer [54]和DreamPhysics [17],它们通过确保模拟动力学保持与现实运动前作一致来优化材料领域. 尽管它们能够从稀少的投入中发现物理学,这些基于优化的范式却受到大量的计算间接费用的影响,往往需要数小时的优化才能解决数十万个物质点. 此外,这些方法的特点是每个场景的重度记忆;对于每个新的场景,必须从零开始进行代价高昂的优化,不能在各种场景中进行概括。

blocks.en: 2.3 Feedforward Physics Property Prediction
blocks.zh: 2.3 向导物理属性预测

blocks.en:
Feedforward methods such as Pixie [ 22 ] and VoMP [ 13 ] have recently emerged to bypass the computational burdens of test-time optimization by directly regressing physical attributes in a single pass. However, these methods rely exclusively on visual cues, which inherently lead to physical ambiguity, i.e . , visually similar objects, such as fresh fruit and its plastic replica, can possess drastically different material properties. To resolve this limitation, AutoPhyX introduces textual constraints as a crucial semantic prior to resolve the visual ambiguities, enabling the differentiation of materials with similar appearances but distinct physical behaviors.
Unlike previous models, our goal is to ensure that the predicted parameters are efficient to compute, controllable, and physically plausible, providing a versatile solution for augmenting diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, and gs .
blocks.zh:
Pixie[22]和VOMP[13]等Feedforward方法最近出现,通过在一次通过中直接递归物理属性来绕过测试时间优化的计算负担. 然而,这些方法完全依靠视觉提示,这本身就会导致物理上的模糊,即,视觉上的类似物体,如新鲜水果及其塑料复制品,可能具有截然不同的物质特性。 为了解决这一限制,AutoPhyX在解决视觉模糊之前引入了文字约束作为关键语义,使得具有类似外观但不同的物理行为的材料得以区分.
与先前的模型不同,我们的目标是确保预测的参数能够高效地计算、可控和在物理上是可信的,为增强包括网格、点云和gs在内的多种三维表示提供多功能解决方案。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of our pipeline. Given a 3D object, our framework first decomposes it into semantically distinct components via multi-view feature rendering. Then, a text-conditioned neural network resolves visual ambiguity through cross-modal modulation, predicting volumetric physical properties in a single forward pass. The predicted properties are formulated as a voxel field, ensuring compatibility with diverse 3D representations, e.g . , meshes, point clouds, and Gaussian Splatting, for physics simulation.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们管道概况。 鉴于一个3D对象,我们的框架首先通过多视图特性渲染将其分解成有分解特征的组件. 然后,一个文本条件的神经网络通过跨模式调制解决视觉模糊性,在单个前传中预测体积物理属性. 预测的属性被配为voxel字段,确保了与多种3D表示的兼容性,例如: meshes,点云,和高斯白板,用于物理模拟.

blocks.en: Given a 3D object represented with multi-view images and a text prompt, our goal is to predict a dense, physics-ready volumetric field of material parameters, specifically Young’s modulus E E , Poisson’s ratio ν \nu , and density ρ \rho . To achieve this, we propose AutoPhyX that operates in two primary stages. First, it extracts 2D OpenCLIP features from multi-view images and lifts them into a dense 3D OpenCLIP voxel grid, explicitly handling self-occlusion via volume rendering and filling the unobservable interior regions to ensure a solid physical volume ( Sec. 3.1 ). Second, we fuse these 3D visual features with textual embeddings to resolve inherent visual ambiguities, directly decoding this cross-modal representation into a unified voxel field of precise physical parameters ready for downstream simulation ( Sec. 3.2 ). We additionally generate a large-scale dataset to facilitate training and testing, as detailed in Sec. 3.3 .

While volume rendering captures surface features, physics-based simulations inherently require volumetric properties, such as ( E , ν , ρ ) (E,\nu,\rho) , defined throughout the object’s interior to accurately model stress propagation. To bridge this gap, we fill unobservable internal voids using a hierarchical ray-casting strategy inspired by PhysGaussian [ 49 ] .
Specifically, following the classic even-odd rule in computer graphics, we identify internal voxels by casting multiple rays to infinity, where a consistently odd number of surface intersections across all rays indicates the voxel is inside, robustly handling complex concavities.
Finally, these voxels inherit semantic features via nearest-neighbor interpolation from the surface, yielding a physically and semantically consistent volumetric representation.

blocks.en: 3.2 Text-conditioned Physical Parameter Prediction
blocks.zh: 3.2 文本条件物理参数预测

blocks.en: While vision-based 3D representations, such as 3D CLIP feature field [ 41 ] , have proven highly effective for open-vocabulary localization and commonsense reasoning, relying solely on pure vision is fundamentally insufficient for predicting physical properties. This limitation arises from the inherent ambiguity of visual appearance. For instance, a rubber toy might look identical whether it is extremely stiff or highly deformable. Therefore, it is essential to introduce textual descriptions as a disambiguating condition, fusing the semantic priors of language with the spatial awareness of 3D visual features to guide the physical reasoning process.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于视觉的3D表示,如3D CLIP的特征字段[41],已被证明对开放-vobulary本地化和常识推理非常有效,但仅仅依靠纯视觉根本不足以预测物理属性. 这种限制源于视觉外观固有的模糊性. 例如,橡胶玩具可能看起来很相似,无论它非常僵硬或极易变形。 因此,必须引入文字描述,将其作为一种脱节的条件,将语言的语义前缀与3D视觉特征的空间意识相融合,以指导物理推理过程.

blocks.en:
Specifically, the textual description is first processed by a frozen OpenCLIP text encoder to extract a dense semantic embedding, denoted as e t ​ e ​ x ​ t e_{text} . Note that since both the 3D visual voxels and the textual embeddings are derived from the OpenCLIP latent space, they are inherently aligned, which avoids the need for complex cross-modal projection or pre-processing modules.
To achieve the cross-modal fusion, we draw inspiration from Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) [ 38 ] , which demonstrates remarkable success in visual reasoning tasks. Rather than naively concatenating this embedding with visual features, e t ​ e ​ x ​ t e_{text} acts as a direct and highly effective global condition to modulate the 3D OpenCLIP visual voxels at multiple scales.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,文字描述首先由一个冷冻的OpenCLIP文本编码器处理,以提取密集的语义嵌入,表示为e t e x t e_{text}. 注意,由于3D视觉Voxels和文字嵌入都来源于OpenCLIP潜在空间,因此它们内在对齐,从而避免了复杂的跨模式投影或预处理模块的需要.
为了实现跨模式聚变,我们从Feature-with Linear Moduction(FiLM)[38]中汲取灵感,这显示了视觉推理任务的显著成功. e t e x t e_{text} 而不是天真地将这种嵌入式具有视觉特性,而是作为直接和高度有效的全球条件,在多个尺度上调制3D OpenCLIP 视觉阴极.

In our design, e t ​ e ​ x ​ t e_{text} is passed through dedicated Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLP) to predict layer-specific modulation parameters: the scaling factor γ \gamma and the shifting factor β \beta . Let F i F_{i} represent the intermediate 3D voxel feature map at the i i -th layer of our U-Net. The FiLM layer applies a channel-wise affine transformation to modulate this feature map: F i ′ = γ i ​ ( e t ​ e ​ x ​ t ) ⋅ F i + β i ​ ( e t ​ e ​ x ​ t ) . This multi-scale, text-driven modulation ensures that the final extracted features are highly attuned to the physical attributes specified in the text, thereby enabling the accurate regression of the target physical parameters. We present a detailed comparison between our design and other multi-modal fusion modules in the Supplementary Material .

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集生成

blocks.en: Unlike Pixie [ 22 ] and VoMP [ 13 ] , which supervise the prediction of each object by a single deterministic set of physical parameters, our approach resolves the inherent ambiguity of prediction by introducing text description as conditioning signals. This formulation supports downstream applications that require flexible object physics, e.g . , increasing the robustness of robot manipulation policy by varying the potential plausible physics for the same object during training. However, such text-conditioned training data are currently unavailable at scale, motivating our automated pipeline for large-scale data generation.
blocks.zh: Pixie [22] 和 VOMP [13] 不同的是,我们的方法通过引入文本描述作为条件信号来解决预测的固有模糊性,后者通过单一的确定性物理参数来监督对每个物体的预测. 这种配体支持下游应用,这些应用需要灵活的物体物理,例如,通过在训练期间改变同一物体可能具有的可信物理学,提高机器人操纵政策的稳健性. 然而,目前还无法大规模获得这种有文字条件的培训数据,这促使我们为大规模数据生成提供自动管道。

blocks.en: To achieve precise text-driven control, e.g . , accurately specifying whether a tree trunk is hardwood or softwood, or adjusting the stiffness of a car’s tires, it is required that our dataset provide accurate part-level segmentation. To this end, we first extract 3D OpenCLIP voxels for each 3D object as in Sec. 3.1 . OpenCLIP voxels have been successfully and widely adopted in object grounding and reasoning [ 41 ] , and their text-aligned semantic features enable segmentation of objects based on corresponding text keywords.
blocks.zh: 为了实现精确的文本驱动控制,例如,精确地说明树干是硬木还是软木,或者调整汽车轮胎的硬度,需要我们的数据集提供准确的分层。 为此,我们首先对Sec中的每个3D对象提取3D OpenCLIP voxels. 3.1 (韩语). OpenCLIP voxels在对象定位和推理[41]中已经成功并被广泛采用,其文本对齐的语义特征使得基于相应文本关键词对对象进行分割成为可能.

blocks.en: To mitigate the ambiguity associated with single-view observations, we uniformly render 15 images from the upper hemisphere of each object. We then prompt vlm [ 12 ] to generate a text list encompassing all constituent parts it identifies for the object. Upon obtaining these text keywords, we compute the segmentation on the OpenCLIP voxels based on the cosine similarity between the text-visual features. To ensure robustness, we repeatedly generate five distinct sets of keywords per object and render their corresponding 3D segmentations, as illustrated in . The vlm finally selects the highest-quality segmentation from these five candidates, which effectively prevents incorrect segmentations caused by the use of uncommon vocabulary for part names.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻与单视观测有关的模糊性,我们统一制作来自每个物体上半球的15幅图像。 然后我们提示 vlm [12] 生成一个包含它为对象识别的所有组成部分的文本列表 。 在获得这些文本关键词后,我们根据文本-视觉特征的余弦相似性,计算OpenCLIP voxels上的分割. 为确保坚固性,我们反复生成每个物体的五套不同的关键词,并制作相应的3D分区,如下文所示。 vlm最终从这5位候选人中选择了质量最高的分区,这有效防止了部分名字使用不常见词汇导致的不正确的分区.

blocks.en:
After part-level segmentation, the next step is to generate the physical properties paired with text descriptions. To resolve the physical ambiguity from pure visual inputs, our guideline is to generate text first to guide the property assignment.
For each object, we randomly select a subset of parts and prompt vlm [ 12 ] to generate physically diverse but plausible textual descriptions, which act as the guideline for parameter assignment. To ground these assignments and prevent potential vlm hallucination, for each description, we prompt vlm to query the corresponding physics parameter range from online databases, i.e . , Matweb [ 30 ] , Wikipedia [ 45 ] , and The Engineering Toolbox [ 15 ] . Once the physics ranges are acquired, we leverage vlm to sample a corresponding parameter in the valid range. For instance, the description “This is mahogany that might sink to the bottom,” would lead to a density value near the upper end of the wood’s density range ( 800 ​ kg/m 3 800\text{ kg/m}^{3} to 1300 ​ kg/m 3 1300\text{ kg/m}^{3} ), whereas “This is softwood that can float on water” yields a lower density. When an object comprises multiple parts, any unmentioned parts are assigned the mean value of their valid physical ranges.
In addition, to ensure robust physical parameter assignment in the absence of detailed textual guidance, for each object, we
include a simple default text description “This is a [object name],” where all parts are assigned the mean value in their
valid ranges.
We further filter generated assignments through simulation-based consistency checks: for each selected object and sampled
physical setting, we generate a 100-frame simulation and reject cases with clear artifacts, poor segmentation, implausible
property assignments, or behavior inconsistent with the generated description. The vlm may resample the assignment up to
five times; objects that still fail this automatic check are discarded.

blocks.en: 5 Experiment
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of AutoPhyX to validate its ability to recover accurate physical constants from visual and linguistic inputs. Our experiments focus on two primary objectives: (1) Quantitative Analysis , where we measure the precision of predicted physics properties on our dataset Text2PhyX and a real-world dataset ABO-500; and (2) Qualitative Simulation , where we demonstrate the practical utility of our framework by applying the predicted physics properties to realistic physics-based simulations, containing both gs and mesh. Through these evaluations, we show that AutoPhyX effectively bridges the gap between high-level semantic descriptions and low-level physical dynamics in an end-to-end manner.
blocks.zh: 我们对AutoPhyX进行全面评估,以验证其从视觉和语言输入中恢复准确物理常数的能力. 我们的实验集中于两个主要目标:(1)定量分析,我们用我们的数据集Text2PhyX和一个现实世界的数据集ABO-500来测量预测物理属性的精度;(2)定性模拟,我们通过将预测物理属性应用于现实物理模拟,同时包含gs和wesh来证明我们的框架的实际效用. 通过这些评价,我们显示AutoPhyX以端到端的方式有效弥合了高层次语义描述和低层次物理动力学之间的差距.

blocks.en: We evaluate text-conditioned physical parameter prediction on the test set of Text2PhyX , detailed in Sec. 3.3 . We measure the discrepancy between the estimated and ground-truth physical parameters. Furthermore, we assess the visual and dynamic quality of renderings from simulations driven by the predicted properties and the ground-truth.

blocks.en:
We compare AutoPhyX against several representative methods. Both OmniPhysGS [ 25 ] and DreamPhysics [ 17 ] utilize video diffusion models to optimize the physics simulation process online.
NeRF2Physics [ 51 ] uses GPT [ 1 ] to generate material text prompts and their physical properties, mapping them to 3D points via text-image CLIP similarity.
We also test representative vlm , Gemini, which we ask to predict the part name and corresponding physics property, and then assign them back to the object corresponding to OpenCLIP feature similarity. To alleviate the randomness of vlm output, we conduct 5 queries and take the average as the final result of Gemini.
Pixie [ 22 ] is a recent feed-forward physics generation method that relies solely on visual features. Since the original dataset for Pixie is not publicly available, we retrain it on our dataset to ensure a fair comparison. Furthermore, as Pixie does not support textual descriptions as input, we evaluate it exclusively under the default unconditional setting described in Sec. 3.3 . We additionally report unconditional cross-dataset comparisons with VoMP [ 13 ] in Supplementary Material .

blocks.en: In Text2PhyX , we evaluate using physical and visual metrics. For physical accuracy, we compute the Mean Squared Error (MSE) for Young’s modulus E E , Poisson’s ratio ν \nu , and density ρ \rho . To handle large magnitude variations, E E and ρ \rho are evaluated in log-space ( log 10 \log_{10} ). This is especially important for Young’s modulus, which spans many orders of magnitude across materials; raw absolute error would be dominated by stiff materials and would underweight soft materials where small absolute changes can strongly alter dynamics. For visual fidelity, we simulate and render images with the predicted properties using PhysGaussian [ 49 ] for gs , and Isaac Sim [ 29 ] for meshes. The rendered frames are then evaluated against ground truth using Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS).
blocks.zh: 在Text2PhyX中,我们使用物理和视觉度量衡来评价. 我们计算Young modulus E E 、 Poisson 比率 = nu 和 密度 × rho 的 平均平方误差。 为了处理大尺度变化, E 和 ^rho 在日志空间( log 10\log\10} ) 中进行评估 。 这对Young的模具尤为重要,它跨越各种材料的许多数量级;原始的绝对误差会以硬质材料为主,并会降低软质材料的重量,而小的绝对变化会强烈改变动态。 对于视觉的忠诚,我们模拟和渲染图像 与预测的属性 使用PhysGausian [49] 对于gs, 和Isaac Sim [29] 对于 meshes。 然后利用峰信号对噪声比率(PSNR)、结构相似性指数计量(SSIM)和学习感知图像补丁相似性(LPIPS),对照地面真实性评估所提供的帧。

blocks.en: On the real-world ABO-500 mass dataset, we report four metrics: ADE (Average Displacement Error), ARE (Average Relative Error), ALDE (Average Log Displacement Error), and MnRE (Minimum Ratio Error). Specifically, ADE measures the absolute numerical difference in weight, while ARE captures the percentage of this error relative to the object’s true weight, which is crucial for lighter items. Furthermore, ALDE evaluates the error in logarithmic space. MnRE avoids bias toward systematic over- or underestimation and reduces sensitivity to outliers, making it particularly effective for evaluating physical quantity predictions across heterogeneous samples.
blocks.zh: 关于现实世界的ABO-500质量数据集,我们报告了四个度量衡:ADE(平均迁移误差)、ARE(平均相对误差)、ALDE(平均逻辑迁移误差)和MnRE(最低比率误差)。 具体而言,ADE衡量加权的绝对数值差异,而ARE则捕捉该错误相对于对象真实重量的百分比,这对于较轻的项目至关重要。 此外,ALDE评价对数空间的错误. MnRE避免了对系统过度估计或低估的偏差,并降低了对外界的敏感度,使其特别有效地评价不同样本的物理量预测。

blocks.en: Quantitative Result
blocks.zh: 量化结果

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. 1 , our method exhibits a significant performance margin over existing baselines. AutoPhyX with
the OpenCLIP features achieves a PSNR of 26.012, outperforming the state-of-the-art Pixie by approximately 2.6 dB. This
significant improvement is primarily attributed to our cross-modal modulation utilizing the text conditions, coupled with
OpenCLIP’s richer semantic representations compared to standard CLIP; they together empower our model to make finer-grained
physical predictions. Pixie, while making reasonable predictions, is constrained to the default physical conditions because
it solely takes CLIP voxel features as input. This reliance on purely visual input suffers from inherent visual ambiguity,
which is more evident on the ABO-500 object mass estimation benchmark.
As shown in Tab. 2 , our method consistently improves accuracy over NeRF2Physics and Pixie, achieving lower ALDE, ADE, ARE, and higher MnRE, which suggests that AutoPhyX not only achieves a good performance on text-conditioned prediction on our dataset, but also generalizes well in the out-of-distribution real-world dataset across diverse physical scenarios.

blocks.en:
Since NeRF2Physics directly relies on GPT for physical property predictions, it inherits inaccurate physical priors and vlm hallucinations. As a result, its performance in terms of physical accuracy and visual fidelity is relatively low.
Similar to NeRF2Physics, directly leveraging Gemini as an agent that predicts physics properties cannot achieve high
precision. While Text2PhyX also employs Gemini for part segmentation and physical property retrieval during data generation, we mitigate these
limitations through a multiple-sampling strategy for robust part segmentation and text-guided property assignment.
Furthermore, we ground our queries in authoritative online databases rather than relying solely on the VLM’s internal
knowledge for physical properties. This also highlights a key asymmetry : vlm s can generate coherent part
descriptions and then produce compatible physical parameters in a forward manner, but they struggle with the inverse problem
that requires specific property estimation from a given text description, because their internal physics knowledge is not
well calibrated for accurate, instance-specific parameter estimation. Consequently, although we utilize Gemini for data
generation, our method leverages large-scale supervised training to improve generalizability and substantially outperform
pure VLM-based baselines across all evaluation metrics.

blocks.en: Since NeRF2Physics directly relies on GPT for physical property predictions, it inherits inaccurate physical priors and vlm hallucinations. As a result, its performance in terms of physical accuracy and visual fidelity is relatively low. Similar to NeRF2Physics, directly leveraging Gemini as an agent that predicts physics properties cannot achieve high precision. While Text2PhyX also employs Gemini for part segmentation and physical property retrieval during data generation, we mitigate these limitations through a multiple-sampling strategy for robust part segmentation and text-guided property assignment. Furthermore, we ground our queries in authoritative online databases rather than relying solely on the VLM’s internal knowledge for physical properties. This also highlights a key asymmetry : vlm s can generate coherent part descriptions and then produce compatible physical parameters in a forward manner, but they struggle with the inverse problem that requires specific property estimation from a given text description, because their internal physics knowledge is not calibrated for accurate, instance-specific parameter estimation. Consequently, although we utilize Gemini for data generation, our method leverages large-scale training to improve generalizability and substantially outperform pure VLM-based baselines across all evaluation metrics.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: 定性结果

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 6 , the versatility of our voxelized prediction approach allows the predicted physical properties to be integrated into diverse simulation pipelines.
For the first six rows, we employ the mpm to drive the dynamic behavior of gs representations, capturing complex physical effects under varying material properties: from rigid rotation to elastic warping of the propeller (Rows 1-2), from gentle swaying to pronounced bending of the ficus in the wind (Rows 3-4), and from an intact collision to brittle fracture of the falling bread (Rows 5-6).

blocks.en: Furthermore, to demonstrate the cross-representation capability, the final two rows present deformable object simulations conducted in Isaac Sim using the fem . Despite the change in both the physical solver and the 3D representation, our model consistently predicts accurate parameters that govern realistic material behaviors, such as volume-preserving bouncing versus large deformation. This highlights that our method learns intrinsic physical attributes that are independent of specific simulators or 3D representations.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 7 , our voxel-based prediction framework achieves significantly higher precision in
material decomposition compared to existing methods. A key limitation of NeRF2Physics is its lack of structural granularity,
which predicts nearly identical physical attributes for different parts, such as assigning uniform Young’s modulus values to
both the foliage and the trunk. On the other hand, Pixie struggles with material boundaries at the base of the object,
predicting that the soil and the ceramic pot have the same physical properties. In contrast, our method successfully recovers
the sharp discontinuities between distinct materials. It accurately distinguishes the rigid trunk from the soft leaf clusters
and maintains a clear boundary between the soil and the rigid container. This heatmap confirms that our model captures
intrinsic semantic-physical correlations beyond simple global averages.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
We presented AutoPhyX , a text-conditioned feed-forward framework that automates dense physical property assignment for
diverse 3D assets. Our method uses a unified voxel field representation to bridge high-level linguistic semantics with low-
level physical dynamics in a scalable manner. To support this cross-modal paradigm, we designed an automated, vlm -driven
generation pipeline and constructed Text2PhyX , a large-scale, multi-part 3D physics dataset for training and testing across
diverse object categories.

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments validate AutoPhyX . Quantitatively, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on our dataset and the real-world ABO-500 benchmark. Qualitatively, our method integrates into simulation pipelines, including mpm and fem , across objects such as a bonsai, a propeller, and bread. These results demonstrate its potential for larger, complex interactive environments. In the future, we plan to extend our framework by incorporating
additional physical properties, such as surface friction and damping coefficients, and by exploring higher-resolution fields for objects with very fine structures.

广泛实验验证AutoPhyX. 从数量上来说,它实现了我们数据集和现实世界ABO-500基准的最先进准确性. 从质量上讲,我们的方法融入了模拟管道, 包括mpm和fem, 跨越诸如bonsai、螺旋桨和面包等物体。 这些结果表明,它具有更大的、复杂的互动环境的潜力。 今后,我们计划扩大框架,纳入
额外的物理性质,如表面摩擦和筑坝系数,以及对结构极细的物体探索更高的分辨率场.

blocks.en: 0.A.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 0.A.1 概览

blocks.en: As introduced in the main text, Text2PhyX is a large-scale, text-conditioned 3D physical property dataset designed to resolve the inherent ambiguity of predicting object mechanics from pure visual inputs. The dataset is built upon a diverse collection of 1,700 unique 3D assets, which are sourced from two distinct domains to ensure both quality and real-world complexity: approximately 1,000 high-quality 3D meshes from the Objaverse dataset, and 700 3D gs ( gs ) models reconstructed from in-the-wild 2D images using SAM 3D Objects.
blocks.zh: 如正文所介绍,Text2PhyX是一个大规模,文字条件化的3D物理属性数据集,旨在解决从纯视觉输入中预测物体力学的固有模糊性. 该数据集建立在1700个独特的3D资产的多样性集合之上,这些资产来源于两个不同的领域,以确保质量和现实世界的复杂性:Objaverse数据集的约1000个高质量的3D meshes,以及700个使用SAM 3D Objects从闪烁的2D图像中重建的3D gs(gs)模型.

blocks.en: To support flexible, text-driven physical predictions, we generate 8 distinct textual descriptions paired with corresponding physical parameters for each base object. Consequently, Text2PhyX comprises a total of 13,600 data triplets. Each triplet consists of: 1. A 3D object representation (dense OpenCLIP semantic voxels extracted from multi-view renderings). 2. A text description specifying the material or physical state of the object’s constituent parts. 3. The ground-truth dense physical parameters, specifically Young’s Modulus ( E E ), Poisson’s Ratio ( ν \nu ), and Density ( ρ \rho ), assigned at the voxel level. The entire dataset is partitioned at the object level into a training set of 12,600 samples from 1,575 objects and a testing set of 1,000 samples from 125 held-out objects, providing a robust benchmark for text-conditioned 3D physical parameter regression.
blocks.zh: 为了支持灵活,文字驱动的物理预测,我们生成了8个不同的文字描述,与每个基对象的相应物理参数对齐. 因此,案文2 PhyX共包含13,600个数据三进制. 每个三进制包括: 1. 3D对象表示(从多视图渲染中提取的ense OpenCLIP语义). 2. 具体说明物体组成部分的物质或物理状态的文字说明。 3. 地面真实密集的物理参数,特别是Young ' s Modulus(E E),Poisson's 比率(ν nu ),和Density(ρ ρ ho ho),它们被分配到阴道一级。 整个数据集在对象层面被分割成由1,575个对象的12,600个样本组成的训练集和由125个搁置对象的1000个样本组成的测试集,为文本条件的3D物理参数回归提供了坚实的基准.

blocks.en: To intuitively demonstrate the diversity and granularity of Text2PhyX , Figure A5 provides a visual gallery showcasing various objects alongside their part-level segmentations and corresponding physical property heatmaps.
blocks.zh: 为了直观地显示Text2PhyX的多样性和颗粒性,图A5提供了一个视觉画廊,展示各种物体及其部分层分和相应的物理属性热图。

blocks.en: To mitigate the ambiguity of single-view observations and extract robust 3D OpenCLIP voxels, we uniformly render multiple views from the upper hemisphere of each object. Based on these visual features and vlm -generated keywords, objects are accurately segmented into constituent parts. As shown in the second column of Figure A5 , a snowman is segmented into its body, arms, and nose; a potted grass is separated into the planter and the green grass; and a bag is distinctly divided into the fabric body and plastic handles. This fine-grained part-level segmentation is crucial for applying localized, text-driven physical controls.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻单视观测的模糊性,并提取坚固的3D OpenCLIP voxels,我们统一从每个对象的上半球产生多种观点. 基于这些视觉特征和vlm - 生成的关键字,对象被精确地分割成组成部分. 如图A5第二栏所示,雪人被分解成身体,手臂和鼻子;盆状草被分离成栽培者和绿草;袋状则被明确分为织物体和塑料柄. 这种精细的分层,对于应用局部的,文字驱动的物理控制至关重要.

blocks.en: Building upon the part segmentation, Text2PhyX provides dense, voxel-wise annotations for three key physical properties. As visualized in the rightmost three columns of Figure A5 , different semantic parts within the same object exhibit distinctly different physical values, reflecting their assigned materials. For example, the wooden trunk of the tree shows a significantly higher Young’s Modulus ( E E ) compared to its leaves, while the plastic handles of the bag exhibit different densities ( ρ \rho ) and elasticity compared to the fabric body. These detailed heatmaps confirm that our automated, text-guided pipeline successfully assigns physically plausible and spatially accurate parameters across a wide variety of complex 3D objects.
blocks.zh: 在部分分割的基础上,Text2PhyX为三个关键物理属性提供了密集的,voxel的注释. 如图A5中最右三栏所示,同一物体内不同的语义部分显示出明显不同的物理值,反映了它们指定的材料。 例如,树的木制树干显示,与树叶相比,Young的Modulus(E E)要高得多,而与织物体相比,袋子的塑料柄呈现出不同的密度和弹性。 这些详细的热图证实,我们的自动、文字制导管道在各种复杂的三维物体上成功地分配了物理上合理和空间上准确的参数。

blocks.en: Figure A3 : Failure case in segmentation. Due to the tight adherence between the trash can’s outer shell and the inner plastic bag, most voxels encapsulate both components post-voxelization. This renders perfect segmentation unattainable regardless of the part name queried in the vlm , since the features within any given voxel are effectively an average of those from both the plastic bag and the trash bin.
blocks.zh: 图A3: 分解失败案例。 由于垃圾罐的外壳和内塑料袋之间的紧密粘合,大多数蒸汽瓶都封装了蒸汽后的两个部件. 这使得无论在 vlm 中询问的部分名称如何, 都无法实现完美的分割, 因为任何给定的 voxel 中的特性实际上都是塑料袋和垃圾桶中的平均值 。

blocks.en: 0.A.3 OpenCLIP-Driven 3D Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: 0.A.3 OpenCLIP - Driven 3D 语义分裂

blocks.en: To endow our volumetric representation with open-vocabulary semantic understanding suitable for physics-based simulation, we distill dense, high-dimensional semantic features from a pre-trained 2D vision-language foundation model (specifically OpenCLIP) into a continuous 3D feature field. Furthermore, to ensure physical accuracy during stress propagation, we extend these surface features into the unobservable internal volume using a robust ray-casting strategy.
blocks.zh: 为了将我们的音量表达方式与适合物理模拟的开放式声波语义理解制成,我们从预先训练的2D视觉语言基础模型(具体来说是OpenCLIP)中提炼出密集的高维语义特征,形成一个连续的3D特征域. 此外,为了确保压力传播期间的物理准确性,我们采用强力射线法,将这些表面特征扩展到无法观察的内部体积。

blocks.en: 2D Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 2D 特性提取

blocks.en: Given a set of multi-view RGB images { 𝐈 k } \{\mathbf{I}_{k}\} of the scene, we first extract 2D semantic feature maps using a pre-trained OpenCLIP image encoder. Since vision transformers typically output features at a lower resolution than the input image, we obtain a dense feature map 𝐅 k ∈ ℝ 512 × 512 × 768 \mathbf{F}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 512\times 768} for each image 𝐈 k \mathbf{I}_{k} , where 768 768 is the dimensionality of the OpenCLIP latent space.
blocks.zh: 考虑到一组多视图的 RGB 图像 { I k } { mathbf{ I}_{k } 的场景,我们首先使用一个预先训练的 OpenCLIP 图像编码器提取 2D 语义特征图 。 由于视觉变压器一般在比输入图像更低的分辨率下输出特性,我们获得密集的特性图F k ∈ R 512 × 512 × 768\ mathbf{F}_{k}\in\ mathbb{R}^{512\times 768},每个图像I k\ mathb{I}_{k},其中768 768是OpenCLIP潜伏空间的维度.

blocks.en: 3D Feature Distillation via Volumetric Rendering
blocks.zh: 3D 特性通过卷曲渲染

blocks.en: Unlike heuristic multi-view projection methods that suffer from occlusion ambiguities, we lift the 2D semantic features into 3D using a physics-inspired volumetric rendering framework. We freeze the density field σ \sigma obtained from a pre-trained RGB NeRF and introduce a continuous 3D feature field Φ : ℝ 3 → ℝ D \Phi:\mathbb{R}^{3}\to\mathbb{R}^{D} , parameterized by a neural network or a feature grid.
blocks.zh: 与受闭塞模糊影响的heuristic多视图投影方法不同,我们使用物理学启发的卷曲渲染框架将2D语义特征提升到3D. 我们冻结从预训的 RGB NERF 中获得的密度字段 \\ sigma , 并引入连续的 3D 特性字段 \ : R 3 ~ R D\ Phi:\ mathbb{ R}^{3}\to\ mathbb{ R}^{D}, 参数化为神经网络或特征网格 。

This naturally handles occlusions by dropping the transmittance to zero behind visible surfaces. We optimize the feature field Φ \Phi by minimizing the discrepancy between the rendered ray features F ^ ​ ( 𝐫 ) \hat{F}(\mathbf{r}) and the corresponding ground-truth OpenCLIP features F k ​ ( 𝐫 ) F_{k}(\mathbf{r}) sampled from the 2D feature maps. We employ the negative cosine similarity loss as our distillation objective: ℒ distill = − 1 N ∑ k ∑ 𝐫 F ^ ​ ( 𝐫 ) ⋅ F k ​ ( 𝐫 ) ‖ F ^ ​ ( 𝐫 ) ‖ 2 ​ ‖ F k ​ ( 𝐫 ) ‖ 2 \mathcal{L}_{\text{distill}}=-\frac{1}{N}\sum_{k}\sum_{\mathbf{r}}\frac{\hat{F}(\mathbf{r})\cdot F_{k}(\mathbf{r})}{\|\hat{F}(\mathbf{r})\|_{2}\|F_{k}(\mathbf{r})\|_{2}} where N N is the total number of sampled rays. By minimizing this loss, the 3D feature field learns to encode view-consistent semantic priors strictly on the visible surfaces.

blocks.en: Internal Volume Filling via Even-Odd Rule
blocks.zh: 内部音量通过 Even-Odd 规则填充

blocks.en: While the volumetric rendering successfully distills features onto the object’s surface, physics-based simulations require semantic and physical properties ( e.g . , Young’s modulus E E , Poisson’s ratio ν \nu ) to be defined throughout the object’s interior. Since internal voids are unobservable from external cameras, their features remain undefined.
blocks.zh: 虽然量子渲染成功地将特性蒸馏到物体表面,但物理模拟需要语义和物理特性(例如,Young的modulus E E,Poisson的===nu)在整个物体内部加以定义。 由于内部空隙无法从外部摄像头中观测到,所以其特征仍然未定义.

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we employ a hierarchical ray-casting strategy based on the classic even-odd rule. For a given unassigned voxel 𝐯 \mathbf{v} in the 3D space, we cast multiple rays uniformly distributed over a sphere towards infinity. Along each ray, we count the number of intersections with the object’s surface (defined by a density threshold on σ \sigma ). If the intersection count is consistently odd across the majority of the casted rays, the voxel 𝐯 \mathbf{v} is robustly classified as being inside the object, effectively handling complex concavities.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了基于经典的偶数规则的分级射线广播战略。 对于3D空间中一个给定的未指定 voxel v\ mathbf{v},我们把多个射线统一分布在一个球体上,走向无限. 沿着每个射线,我们计算与物体表面的交叉点数(以\\sigma上的密度阈值定义). 如果交叉点数在大多数铸造的射线上始终是奇数,则voxel v\mathbf{v}被强烈地归类为物体内部,有效处理复杂的凝聚.

blocks.en: Finally, for each identified internal voxel, we assign its semantic feature by performing nearest-neighbor interpolation from the optimized surface feature field Φ \Phi . This ensures that the internal volume inherits semantically and physically consistent properties from its closest bounding surface, yielding a complete volumetric representation ready for downstream simulation.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们通过从最优化的表层特征域 \\ Phi 中进行最近的邻里插值来分配其语义特征。 这保证了内部体积从最接近的界面继承出精密和物理上一致的特性,从而产生完整的体积表示,可供下游模拟使用。

blocks.en: Open-Vocabulary Querying
blocks.zh: 开放词汇 查询

blocks.en: Once the 3D feature distillation is complete, the scene can be queried using natural language. Given a user-provided text prompt ( e.g . , "a red apple" or "the handle of the mug"), we encode the text into a 768-dimensional embedding 𝐭 \mathbf{t} using the OpenCLIP text encoder.
blocks.zh: 3D特性蒸馏完成后,可以使用自然语言询问场景. 鉴于用户提供的文本提示(如"红苹果"或"杯柄"),我们使用OpenCLIP文本编码器将文本编码为768维嵌入t\mathbf{t}.

This continuous similarity field not only enables robust part-level segmentation but also facilitates downstream tasks such as language-guided robotic grasping and interaction.

blocks.zh: 0.A.4 vlm 标签

blocks.en: Figure A4 : Example of VLM-driven physical property augmentation. The figure illustrates the automated data annotation process for a 3D object. From left to right: multi-view RGB images of a soda can, its corresponding 3D point cloud representation, and the VLM-generated JSON metadata. Based on the augmented semantic description (“The soda can is now made of a very hard plastic”), the VLM successfully modifies the object’s physical parameters, such as scaling the Young’s modulus ( E E ) with a specific multiplier.
blocks.zh: 图A4:VLM驱动的物理属性增强实例. 该图说明了三维对象的自动数据注释过程. 从左到右:一个汽水罐的多视图RGB图像,其相应的3D点云表示,以及VLM生成的JSON元数据. 根据增强的语义描述(“现在汽水可以由非常硬的塑料制成”),VLM成功地修改了物体的物理参数,例如用特定的乘数来缩放Young的模具(E E).

blocks.en: To further illustrate the automated data generation pipeline described in Section 3.3 , Figure A4 provides a concrete example of our text-guided property assignment process. As discussed in the main text, relying solely on visual inputs for physical parameter prediction is inherently ill-posed. To resolve this, we utilize a vlm to generate diverse, physically plausible textual descriptions and assign corresponding physical parameters.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步说明第3.3节所述的自动数据生成程序,图A4提供了我们以文字指导的财产转让程序的具体实例。 如正文所述,仅依靠视觉输入来进行物理参数预测,本质上是不可靠的。 为了解决这个问题,我们利用一个vlm生成多样的,物理上可行的文字描述,并指定相应的物理参数.

blocks.en: In this example, the input consists of multi-view RGB renderings of a soda can and its extracted 3D representation. During the augmentation phase, the vlm generates a novel semantic condition: “The soda can is now made of a very hard plastic.” Rather than blindly guessing the physical values, the vlm grounds its assignment by querying external knowledge bases. As shown in the generated JSON metadata, the model explicitly provides its reasoning trace (“from wiki”) to prevent hallucination.
blocks.zh: 在这个例子中,输入包括一个汽水罐的多视图RGB渲染及其提取的3D代表. 在增强阶段,vlm生成一个新的语义条件: “现在汽水罐是用非常硬的塑料制成的。” Vlm不是盲目猜测物理值,而是通过查询外部知识基础来证明它的任务。 正如生成的JSON元数据所示,该模型明确提供了其推理痕量(“从wiki”)来防止幻觉.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.B Additional Evaluation and Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录0.B 其他评价和分析

blocks.en: 0.B.1 Human-Annotated Text Generalization
blocks.zh: 0.B.1 人类附加说明的案文

blocks.en: To further evaluate text generalization beyond Text2PhyX , we construct a human-annotated test set of 30 objects. For each material category, we query The Engineering Toolbox to obtain plausible physical-property ranges, retrieve corresponding object images, and reconstruct 3D assets using SAM 3D Objects. We sample two material-property configurations from the queried ranges and run physics simulation for each sample. Human annotators then watch these videos and provide the corresponding natural language descriptions, making this evaluation independent of the text-generation pipeline used to build Text2PhyX .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价文本在Text2PhyX之外的一般化,我们构建了一套由30个物体组成的人类附加说明的测试集. 对于每个材料类别,我们查询工程工具箱,以获取可信的物理属性范围,检索相应的对象图像,并使用SAM 3D对象重建3D资产. 我们从被询问范围中抽取了两个物产配置,并对每个样本进行物理模拟。 人类注释者随后观看了这些视频,并提供了相应的自然语言描述,使得本评价独立于用于构建Text2PhyX的文本生成管道.

blocks.en: 0.B.2 Unconditional Cross-Dataset Validation
blocks.zh: 0.B.2 无条件交叉数据集验证

blocks.en: To evaluate whether our framework is tied only to Text2PhyX , we also compare Pixie, VoMP, and our model under an unconditional protocol using an empty text input. We train and test the methods on the Pixie dataset, the VoMP dataset, and Text2PhyX , respectively. This setting is not designed to test text controllability; rather, it checks whether the voxel-based feed-forward architecture remains competitive when reduced to the same unconditional setting as prior feed-forward methods.
blocks.zh: 为了评价我们的框架是否仅与Text2PhyX绑定,我们还用空文本输入来比较Pixie,VOMP,和我们的模式在一个无条件的协议下. 我们分别在Pixie数据集、VOMP数据集和Text2PhyX上培训和测试方法。 此设置并非用来测试文本的可控性;相反,它检查以 voxel 为基础的向导架构在降低到与先前的向导方法相同的无条件设置时是否仍然具有竞争力.

blocks.en: 0.B.3 Resolution Discussion
blocks.zh: 0.B.3 决议讨论

blocks.en: Our current model predicts a 64 3 64^{3} voxel field. While this resolution is lower than the grids commonly used for high-quality 3D reconstruction, it is often sufficient for current physical-property prediction and downstream simulation settings. For example, PhysGaussian uses an effective simulation resolution around 50 3 50^{3} , which is lower than our prediction grid. Since many simulators operate at a similar effective resolution, much finer grids do not necessarily lead to proportional gains in simulation quality. Higher resolution may help with very fine structures, but also incurs significant GPU memory cost; we therefore leave higher-resolution prediction as future work.
blocks.zh: 我们目前的模型预测一个64 3 643 = voxel 球场。 虽然这个分辨率低于通常用于高质量3D重建的网格,但往往足以进行目前的物理财产预测和下游模拟设置. 例如,PhysGausian使用50 3 50^{3}左右的有效模拟分辨率,这低于我们的预测网格. 由于许多模拟器以类似的有效分辨率运行,许多更精细的网格并不一定会导致模拟质量的成比例增益. 更高的分辨率可能帮助建立非常精细的结构,但也会产生很大的GPU内存成本;因此,我们留下更高的分辨率预测作为未来的工作.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.C AutoPhyX Architecture
blocks.zh: 附录 0.C 自动 PhyX 架构

blocks.en: 0.C.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 0.C.1 概览

blocks.en: We propose a text-conditioned 3D U-Net architecture designed to predict continuous physical material parameters (and optionally discrete material segmentation) from dense semantic voxel grids. To effectively fuse high-dimensional visual features with linguistic cues, our architecture is built upon three core components: (1) a Feature Projector for dimensionality reduction of the input semantic features; (2) a hierarchical 3D U-Net Backbone that preserves fine-grained spatial topologies and processes geometric structures across multiple resolutions; and (3) a FiLM-based Conditioning Module (Feature-wise Linear Modulation) that dynamically injects text embeddings into the residual blocks, ensuring that the semantic priors guide the spatial feature extraction at every resolution level.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个文字条件化的3D U-Net架构,旨在预测来自稠密语义 voxel 网格的连续物理物质参数(和可选的离散物质分割). 为了有效地将高维视觉特征与语言提示相结合,我们的架构建立在三个核心组成部分之上: (1)一个用于减量化输入语义特征的特性投影仪; (2)一个分级的3D U-Net Backbone,通过多个分辨率保存精细的空间地形和过程几何结构;以及 (3)一个基于FiLM的附加条件模块(Feature-wise Linear Modulation),动态地将文本嵌入到剩余块中,确保语义前缀指导每个分辨率层次的空间特征提取.

blocks.en: 0.C.5 Comparison with Other Architectures
blocks.zh: 0.C.5 与其他建筑的比较

blocks.en: Table A3 : Ablation Study of different model architectures. All models are trained on a subset of Text2PhyX (2,700 train / 1,000 test) for 30 epochs. The results demonstrate that the high-resolution input information is strong enough to generate accurate physics parameters. Architectures that require spatial downsampling or average pooling of the input ( e.g . , to accommodate sequence lengths) suffer a significant drop in predictive capability.

blocks.en: To evaluate the efficacy of our FiLM-conditioned 3D U-Net, we compare it against alternative sequence-based architectures, including a 3D Transformer and VisualRWKV, as detailed in Table A3 . Surprisingly, despite the strong global modeling capabilities typically associated with attention mechanisms, our lightweight FiLM U-Net achieves significantly lower errors across all predicted physical parameters ( log ⁡ E \log E , ν \nu , and log ⁡ ρ \log\rho ). We attribute this performance gap to the architectural differences in handling 3D spatial topologies and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们的FiLM条件的3D U-Net的功效,我们把它与基于序列的替代架构进行比较,包括一个3D变形器和VisualRWKV,详见表A3. 出乎意料的是,尽管通常与关注机制相关的强大的全球建模能力,但我们轻量级的FiLM U-Net在所有预测物理参数上实现了显著较低的差错(log ⁡ E\log E, ν ν ν ν ρ ρ ρ). 我们将此性能差距归因于处理3D空间地形和计算效率的建筑差异.

blocks.en: To adapt the 3D voxel inputs for sequence-based models, specific architectural compromises are required. For the Transformer baseline, feeding the original 64 3 64^{3} voxel grid directly is computationally intractable due to the O ⁡ ( N 2 ) O(N^{2}) complexity of global self-attention (which would yield a sequence length of 262,144 tokens). Therefore, the input must first be spatially downsampled (via average pooling or strided convolutions) to a 16 3 16^{3} resolution before being flattened into a 1D sequence of 4,096 tokens. The VisualRWKV baseline, utilizing a linear RNN formulation with O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) complexity, can afford a higher spatial resolution of 32 3 32^{3} (32,768 tokens), but still requires aggressive input downsampling and 1D flattening. As highlighted in our results, this forced spatial pooling prematurely discards crucial fine-grained geometric information, directly dropping the model’s predictive capability.
blocks.zh: 为调整基于序列的模型的3D voxel输入,需要具体的建筑妥协. 对于变形器基线来说,直接输入原始的64 3 64^{3} voxel 网格在计算上是难以解决的,因为全球自觉O ⁡(N 2) O(N^{2})的复杂性(这会产生262 144个令牌的序列长度). 因此,输入必须首先在空间上下取样(通过平均集合或斜缩演化)到16 3 16^{3}的分辨率,然后被平整成4 096个符号的1D序列。 VisualRWKV基线采用线性RNN配体,O ⁡(N) O(N)复杂,可承受32 3 32^{3}(32 768个令牌)的更高空间分辨率,但仍需要积极的输入下采样和1D平整. 正如我们的结果所强调,这种强迫空间集合过早地抛弃了关键的精细几何信息,直接降低了模型的预测能力。

blocks.en: A fundamental flaw in applying sequence models to this task lies in how they process spatial structures. The OpenCLIP features utilized in our pipeline inherently capture rich visual priors learned from 2D images. When these features are lifted and aggregated into a 3D voxel grid, they establish a highly structured geometric and topological representation of the object. Flattening this 3D grid into a 1D sequence forces the Transformer and VisualRWKV to completely re-learn these pre-established spatial relationships and 3D topologies from scratch. Given our relatively small training dataset (2,700 samples), demanding the network to rediscover complex geometric priors is exceedingly difficult and highly prone to overfitting. In contrast, the 3D convolutions in our U-Net natively operate on the grid, preserving and directly exploiting this inherent 3D topology.
blocks.zh: 将序列模型应用于这项任务的一个根本缺陷在于它们如何处理空间结构。 管道中使用的OpenCLIP特性内在地捕捉从2D图像中吸取的丰富的视觉前传. 当这些特征被抬升并聚合成3D voxel网格时,它们建立了高度结构化的物体几何和地形代表. 将这个3D网格固定为1D序列,迫使变形器和VisualRWKV从头开始完全重新学习这些预先确定的空间关系和3D地形. 鉴于我们的培训数据集相对较小(2 700个样本),要求网络重新发现复杂的几何前科极为困难,而且极易过于适应。 反之,我们U-Net的3D进化在网络上本土运作,保护和直接利用这种固有的3D地形。

blocks.en: Because sequence baselines suffer from the aforementioned resolution bottlenecks ( 16 3 16^{3} or 32 3 32^{3} ), they struggle to predict physics parameters that rely heavily on micro-structures and volumetric thickness. Our FiLM U-Net circumvents this bottleneck by natively processing the high-resolution 64 3 64^{3} voxel grids. Through its hierarchical encoder-decoder structure, the network preserves fine-grained geometry at the 64 3 64^{3} level while extracting deep semantics at the 8 3 8^{3} bottleneck. Combined with multi-scale FiLM modulation, the network successfully injects text conditioning at all geometric levels, leading to superior regression accuracy without destroying the underlying spatial structure.
blocks.zh: 由于序列基线受到上述分辨率瓶颈(16 3 16^{3}或32 3 32^{3})的影响,它们难以预测严重依赖微观结构和体积厚度的物理参数。 我们的FiLM U-Net通过本土处理高清64 3 64^{3} voxel 网格来规避这个瓶颈. 通过其分级编码器-解码器结构,网络保留了64 3 64^{3}的精细几何,同时在8 3 8^{3}的瓶颈上提取深层语义. 结合多尺度的FiLM调制,网络在所有几何级别上成功注入文本调制,从而在不破坏基础空间结构的情况下,实现优等回归精度.

blocks.en: Unlike the hybrid particle-grid approach of MPM, the fem operates directly on a connected mesh structure, typically composed of tetrahedral or hexahedral elements. The continuum is discretized into vertices (nodes) and elements. The vertices carry the primary kinematic state: m i , 𝐗 i , 𝐱 i , 𝐯 i , 𝐟 i m_{i},\;\mathbf{X}_{i},\;\mathbf{x}_{i},\;\mathbf{v}_{i},\;\mathbf{f}_{i} where m i m_{i} is the nodal mass, 𝐗 i \mathbf{X}_{i} and 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} are the initial and current positions, 𝐯 i \mathbf{v}_{i} is the velocity, and 𝐟 i \mathbf{f}_{i} is the force. The elements e e carry the deformation state, notably the deformation gradient 𝐅 e \mathbf{F}_{e} . FEM is widely adopted for simulating deformable solids due to its accuracy in preserving volume and capturing rich elastic behaviors without the numerical dissipation often seen in grid-based transfers.

FEM in Modern GPU-Accelerated Simulators
blocks.zh: 现代GPU加速模拟器中的FEM

blocks.en: Recent advancements in physics simulation have heavily leveraged GPU acceleration to simulate high-fidelity FEM meshes at interactive or faster-than-real-time rates. Platforms such as NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Gym provide robust, hardware-optimized implementations of FEM for soft body dynamics.
blocks.zh: 物理学模拟的近期进步极大地利用了GPU加速,以交互或比实时更快的速度模拟高真性FEM meshes. NVIDIA Omniverse和Isaac Gym等平台为软体动力提供了强大,硬件优化的FEM执行.

blocks.en: In these environments, the FEM pipeline is parallelized across thousands of CUDA cores. Isaac Gym, in particular, allows for massive parallelization of environments (tensorized simulation), which is highly beneficial for training Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents. By representing deformable objects as tetrahedral FEM meshes within these platforms, researchers can achieve physically accurate sim-to-real transfer for robotic manipulation tasks involving soft materials. The underlying solvers in these engines often employ advanced techniques, such as XPBD (Extended Position-Based Dynamics) or GPU-based Newton-descent solvers, to maintain stability even under large deformations and complex collision scenarios.
blocks.zh: 在这些环境中,FEM管道平行于数千个CUDA核心. 特别是Isaac Gym允许环境的大规模平行化(强化模拟),这对培训强化学习(RL)代理商非常有益. 通过在这些平台内将可变形物体作为四面体FEM meshes来表示,研究者可以实现物理上准确的sim-to-real转移,用于涉及软材料的机器人操纵任务. 这些引擎中的基础解析器经常采用先进的技术,如XPBD(Extended Phase-Based Dynamics)或基于GPU的牛顿-世系解析器,即使在大变形和复杂碰撞情景下也能保持稳定性.
